# SQLite runtime

`sql-wasm.js` and `sql-wasm.wasm` are the pinned sql.js v1.16.0 browser build from [the sql.js npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/sql.js/v/1.16.0). The runtime is bundled with Devoal so SQL practice works without a third-party CDN request. sql.js is MIT licensed; see `sql-js-LICENSE.txt`. SQLite is public domain.
